name: runner-radar
description: Live radar for your self-hosted GitHub Actions runners inside Claude Code: who is busy with what, what is waiting and why, what broke, and an estimated GitHub-hosted equivalent of the minutes your runners ran.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane, status line and alerts: en (English) or es (Español). /radar es or /radar en switches it for the session.

owner.title: GitHub owner
owner.description: Organization or user whose self-hosted runners and repos to watch (e.g. my-org). You can also run /radar <owner>.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Comma-separated repo names to watch. Leave empty to watch the most recently pushed repos of the owner.

max_repos.title: Max repos (auto mode)
max_repos.description: How many recently pushed repos to watch when Repositories is empty.

interval_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
interval_seconds.description: How often to poll GitHub. Busy repos can use up to 9 calls per watched repo; use a longer interval or watch fewer repos to stay within the API limit.

queue_alert.title: Queue alert (jobs)
queue_alert.description: Toast when this many self-hosted jobs are waiting. 0 turns it off.

wait_alert_minutes.title: Wait alert (minutes)
wait_alert_minutes.description: Toast when a self-hosted job has been waiting this long. 0 turns it off.

savings.title: Hosted-equivalent estimate
savings.description: Show an estimated GitHub-hosted equivalent of this month's self-hosted minutes: hypothetical, not a bill or actual savings. Uses at most 30 API requests per pass and 150 per hour.

price_per_minute.title: Comparison rate (USD/min)
price_per_minute.description: Per-minute GitHub-hosted rate the estimate uses. 0.006 is standard Linux x64 2-core; check https://docs.github.com/en/billing/reference/actions-runner-pricing for other runner types.
